text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished for rc-2026-03-22-9 on cluster canary-usw2. Post-deploy mini-synth started: prefill_probe_v2 (targets 200 reqs). Observed ~8% oscillation in prefix hit rate and p95 +220ms. Tagging #eng-releases :eyes:

maria: saw the alert, pulling logs now. was this rolled past quant2 model? @ashwin

ashwin: yep, canary is on quant2-llama-13b-amx. quick grep shows tokenizer warnings on a subset of probes: 'unknown_token: 0xEF' — looks like a byte-level mismatch in prefill inputs.

qa-ryan: reproducer (local):
`curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/synth -d '{"prompt":"Hello\n"}' | jq .latency`
getting p95 spike when run in tight loop.

ashwin: also saw CPU on inference pods jump ~50% during prefill fanout (metric: cpu.user). might be quantized kernel fallback thrash.

sre-jen: if kernel fallback is thrashing we should limit synth fanout. can we throttle synth to 20rps for a quick verification window? @maria

maria: throttling now via deploybot: synth-rate=20 — running short window.

deploy-bot: synth-rate updated to 20rps for canary-usw2. Running 2m verification window. :ok_hand:

qa-ryan: replaying the failing set against the earlier float16 variant to compare results.

ashwin: quick diff: float16 p95 stable, quant2 p95 spikes correlate with tokenizer warnings. hypothesis: tokenizer emits extra surrogate tokens causing KV-cache desync in some streams.

sre-jen: risk is tail latency regression for prod. options: rollback canary to previous variant, or route synthetic probes to float16 while keeping user traffic on quant2. thoughts?

maria: prefer targeted mitigation: divert synthetic probes and keep user traffic on quant2. need a follow-up eval for tokenization edgecases.

ashwin: config ready: reroute synth to model=float16 (route id synth-only-2026-03-22). can apply now.

maria: apply it and increase tracing sample to 100% for 2m.

deploy-bot: Applied route synth-only-2026-03-22 -> float16. Tracing set to 100% for canary-synth. Verification window started.

qa-ryan: initial results: synth p95 back to baseline, no tokenizer warnings in float16 traces. :relieved: 

sre-jen: ok good. hold rollout until root-cause. create ticket and mark rollout paused. @maria please open a follow-up ticket.

maria: ticket INF-2026-117 created. summary: quant2 tokenizer mismatch in prefill leading to transient p95 spikes. attached logs and reproducer.

ashwin: will add kernel trace and reproduce steps. will work the fix on tokenizer layer + fallback path.

maria: for now we'll keep synth rerouted for 24h and then re-run expanded regression harness. if stable, proceed with canary ramp.

sre-jen: +1. closing loop: rollout paused, synth diverted, ticket INF-2026-117, owner ashwin. thanks team. :thumbsup:
